verdict.rationale: Proton Pass ships an official CLI that can create, read, update and delete vaults and many item types, and can retrieve secrets in scripts and CI/CD. That gives programmatic access to core vault and item management. However, the pack documents no public API, and nothing shows parity with UI features such as aliases, sharing, Pass Monitor, attachments or emergency access. Missing for 10: a documented public API, evidence of UI parity for aliases/sharing/monitor/attachments/emergency access/import-export, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Create, read, update, and delete vaults
View, create, update, and delete items including passwords, secure notes, credit cards, identities, WiFi entries, custom items, and stored SSH-key items
the CLI enables you to securely retrieve secrets and other items across scripts, deployments, and continuous integration/ continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.
